text: A circle of radius $1$ is surrounded by $4$ circles of radius $r$ as shown. What is $r$?
figure: Four congruent circles of radius r are arranged in a 2-by-2 square: each large circle is tangent to the circle beside it and to the circle above or below it. A small circle of radius 1 sits in the gap at the center and is tangent to all four large circles. Each large circle has a horizontal radius drawn from its center to the right and labeled r; the small circle has a horizontal radius labeled 1.
